subject: Application with Google Maps failing to start

messages.author: 96ac8657240877c2
messages.subject: Application with Google Maps failing to start
parts:
Dear all, 

I have created a demo application that works well in my local environment, but after uploading it to the server, I'm getting this error:

spatstat 1.36-0 (nickname: 'Intense Scrutiny') For an introduction to spatstat, type 'beginner' Loading required package: ggplot2 Loading required package: bitops Map from URL : http://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/staticmap?center=Aizu+Wakamatsu&zoom=14&size=%20640x640&scale=%202&maptype=roadmap&sensor=false Google Maps API Terms of Service : http://developers.google.com/maps/terms

 I can't tell what's going on because I can't see the logs, any help is appreciated.

Thanks,

messages.author: 96ac8657240877c2
messages.subject: Re: Application with Google Maps failing to start
parts:
Nevermind,

I increase the size of the application to large and now it works.

Sorry for the noise...
